title: The tensor-power coproduct algebra of an invertible sheaf
statement: For a scheme X and an invertible O_X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module], there exist a commutative O_X-algebra sheaf B [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf] and module maps b_d:L.tensorPow d→U(B), for d in N, whose cofan is a coproduct. On every open U and for every a,d and sections s of L^a and t of L^d, b_a(s)b_d(t)=b_(a+d)(tensorPowAddIso(a,d)^(-1)(tmulSection(s,t))). This is solely a construction on X, with no morphism of schemes or quotient algebra.

source.place: Tag 09MS, the middle algebra of the direct-sum sequence following coherent-equation-ses; expanded local-frame construction in lem-sc-tensor-graded-algebra-data step 1

proof.text: Choose local frames of L. On each frame open form the polynomial algebra sheaf. A change of frame by a unit v acts by T↦vT and on degree d by v^d. The cocycle identities glue these algebras and their coefficient structure maps to B, and glue the monomial maps to b_d.

The underlying module of the local polynomial sheaf is the sheafification of finite sums of monomials, hence is the coproduct of its homogeneous module sheaves. A family of maps from the homogeneous terms to any module sheaf extends locally and uniquely by finite summation and the sheafification universal property. These extensions agree on overlaps and glue, giving the global coproduct universal property. No equality between sections of an infinite sheaf coproduct and the direct sum of sections is asserted.

On each frame multiplication of monomials is (sT^a)(tT^d)=stT^(a+d). The tensor-power addition isomorphism identifies st with the tensor product of the two sections. Transition maps preserve the identity, and separation extends it to every open. Degree zero, zero sections and the empty open obey the same calculation.

mathlib_searches.results: SheafOfModules.pullbackObjFreeIso, ModuleCat.tilde, CommRing.Pic.mapAlgebra. No tensor-power algebra sheaf coproduct theorem.
Cofan.IsColimit.desc, fac, mk and Cofan.isColimitMapCoconeEquiv provide colimit glue, but do not construct an algebra sheaf.

Mathlib has symmetric and tensor algebras for ring modules and Proj structure sheaves; no algebra sheaf realizing the coproduct of tensor powers. The project QuasiCoherentSymmetricAlgebra theorem lacks the homogeneous coproduct comparison. Whole-DAG/blueprint searches found no duplicate.

lean.statement: theorem exists_tensorPowerAlgebraCoproduct {X : Scheme.{u}} (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] : ∃ (B : X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (b : ∀ d : ℕ, L.tensorPow d ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B) b)) ∧ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a d : ℕ) (s : Γ(L.tensorPow a, U)) (t : Γ(L.tensorPow d, U)), (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b a).app U s) * (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b d).app U t) = (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b (a + d)).app U ((L.tensorPowAddIso a d).inv.app U (tmulSection s t)))
